resources.string: Send a report to the AgentoC developer. We send the reason, optional note, app version and report ID. The reply excerpt is sent only if you select it below. No workbench or sign-in credentials are attached. This phone keeps a private copy until you clear it.
Include an editable excerpt of this reply
To report specific content, open a conversation and choose Report under the AI reply. Your last submitted report will also appear here.
This is your saved report. Its contents are frozen; opening this page does not send it again.
Received by the developer service. Human review is pending.
Receipt not confirmed. Check the original report before retrying.

This only clears the copy and receipt on this phone. It does not withdraw or delete a report already received by the developer. If receipt is unconfirmed, clearing also removes your ability to check or retry that report here.
The private report record could not be read or saved. A report may already have been received. Keep this record and check again; do not assume it was withdrawn.
The report service is unavailable. Receipt has not been confirmed for this attempt. Keep this report and check again later.
The report service is busy. Keep this report and try again later.
The report was rejected. Shorten the note or excerpt in a new report after clearing this phone copy.
A report with this ID already exists or its contents differ. Check the original receipt; do not assume a new report was received.
The result could not be confirmed. Your saved request is retained. Check its receipt; opening this page will not retry automatically.
